title: MCP server, URL tools, console index, workspace notes, Beacon, endpoint discovery, clouds, engine and finding explanations, corpus engines, native import, guidance, vertical, Secure by Design

coverage.measure: line+branch, the 15 files, their own tests plus tests/test_c6_misc.py

checks.what: The MCP server exposes four read tools only; none takes a secret, a confirmation or a write switch
No secret in any MCP tool result, the failed sign-in and raised checks included
MCP tool arguments validated (cloud, vanity, caps, control characters)
MCP HTTP transport loopback by default; beyond it only on purpose
URL, domain, IP, range, IDN and IPv6 classification against an oracle table
Custom URL category analyzer verdicts, 429 pacing, Stop, cap, IDN matching
Formula-looking tenant URLs are text in the workbooks
URLs export and analyzer read only what the Scope page ticks
Console index cache never answers for another tenant
Console index holds no user, device or description
Workspace notes caps (text, tags, store bytes) at their boundaries
Tags refuse markup; links same-origin only; pages render notes through DOM text
Notes store and lock owner-only
Damaged store and invisible characters
Every Beacon fetch goes through the https host allowlist with checked redirects; the tenant watch is GET-only
Beacon history keeps no token
discover_endpoints: no values kept, owner-only output, no redirects, vanity checked, errors masked
Token URL, OneAPI gateway and classic API host per cloud equal SDK 1.11.3's own builders
engine_explain and plain_english against every operator and section
Local detectors and engine evaluation against published reference values and every operator
Native export conversion never carries a tenant-specific id
Secure by Design page reports live evidence and no secret

findings.title: Unknown cloud (tool argument or ZSCALER_CLOUD) silently signed in to the commercial cloud
findings.fix: refused before sign-in with zscaler_clouds.normalize

findings.title: A check that raised put its message unmasked into the MCP result
findings.fix: tenant_auth.mask_secrets on every exception detail

findings.title: MCP tool arguments uncapped, control characters accepted, empty section ran every check, client not closed on failed sign-in
findings.fix: arguments capped at 200 characters, control characters refused, empty section refused, client closed in finally

findings.title: Unauthenticated MCP server bound beyond loopback with a warning only
findings.fix: refused (exit 2) unless --allow-remote

findings.title: url_tools.kind_of called hex-like domains (dead-beef.cc) IP ranges
findings.fix: both ends of a range must parse as IP addresses

findings.title: URL lookup answer not matched when the host is internationalised (Unicode vs IDNA; lookup spelling assumed)
findings.fix: match key encodes non-ASCII hosts to IDNA on both sides

findings.title: Custom category analyzer counted the tenant's other custom categories as Zscaler's categorisation
findings.fix: CUSTOM_ ids are not Zscaler's categories

findings.title: URLs export iterated a non-list tenant field character by character or crashed
findings.fix: _list() accepts lists only in collect and the lookup answer

findings.title: Console index cache: typed sign-ins of every tenant shared one bucket named like a valid profile id, and the latest-index lookup could answer for another tenant
findings.fix: bucket name no profile can take; cache_latest matches the tenant label and denies without profile or tenant

findings.title: GET /api/console-index/cached does not say which tenant the page is signed in to, so for typed sign-ins it can no longer return an index (fail closed) and for an edited profile it cannot check the tenant
findings.fix: server passes the signed-in tenant's label to console_index.cache_latest; Find anything sends its sign-in

findings.title: A damaged workspace notes store (bucket or note not an object, deep nesting) made every notes read raise
findings.fix: _read keeps only entries of the store's shape; RecursionError reads as empty

findings.title: Bidi overrides, C1 controls and line separators were kept in note text
findings.fix: _clean strips them

findings.title: Beacon kept tenant-watch errors unredacted in beacon_state.json (a gateway page echoing the Authorization header)
findings.fix: tenant_auth.redact_tokens before cutting and keeping

findings.title: Beacon history load raised on a state file nested past the parser; a non-numeric status raised
findings.fix: RecursionError is an empty history; status coerced

findings.title: discover_endpoints wrote the first item of every endpoint as values (a person's device on /zcc/devices) to a file anyone on the machine could read
findings.fix: field names and value types only, written owner-only

findings.title: discover_endpoints followed redirects on the token POST (307/308 repeats the secret) and the probes
findings.fix: allow_redirects=False; a token redirect is an error

findings.title: discover_endpoints crashed on a config without a cloud and printed sign-in errors unmasked
findings.fix: load_config checks the file in plain words; cloud defaults to production; errors masked

findings.title: engine_explain read D.S >= 0 (always true) as 'at least one match', < 0 (never true) as 'no match', and != garbled
findings.fix: always-true and never-true bounds said as such; != reads 'other than n'

findings.title: plain_english gave section 5 (Endpoint DLP rules, dictionaries, EDM) the endpoint channel's outcome; its own entry was unreachable
findings.fix: the section-5 entry is matched before Ch.B's 'endpoint'

findings.title: corpus_engines summed only the first dictionary of a Sum written in the D(n) form
findings.fix: every id of the group is summed

findings.title: corpus_engines listed the Sum's stand-in term (D900000) as a dictionary and could collide with a real id
findings.fix: stand-in numbered above every real id and not listed

findings.title: Canadian SIN detector could never match (luhn_ok's 12-digit card minimum)
findings.fix: nine-digit Luhn check of its own

findings.title: itin_ok accepted ITIN groups the IRS does not issue (66-69, 89, 93)
native_zscaler kept the source tenant's dictionary id in an engine whose term was D{id}.U or D({id}), silently pointing at another dictionary in the target tenant
findings.fix: such an engine is left out with a warning

findings.title: native_zscaler split a single string value (fileTypes "PDF") into characters and recursed into sub-rules without bound
findings.fix: _as_list; sub-rules one level, deeper dropped with a warning

findings.title: guidance turned a library entry with a javascript:, data: or protocol-relative URL into a proposal that links to it
findings.fix: only http(s) URLs become proposals; others recorded as no action

findings.title: guidance.evaluate stopped on a non-numeric first_seen or a non-object entry
findings.fix: such entries skipped or read defensively

findings.title: vertical.normalize_industry matched substrings: 'Real estate' read State & local, 'FedEx' Federal
findings.fix: word-boundary patterns

findings.title: Secure by Design audit control read audit.log beside the app, so in the container (DLP_CHECK_AUDIT) it reported no writes
findings.fix: audit.path()

findings.title: scenario_flow input check let DEL and C1 control characters through
findings.fix: C0, DEL and C1 refused

findings.title: MCP get_health, the configuration check, raised on an unknown ZSCALER_AUTH_METHOD
findings.fix: reports status misconfigured with the reason

notes: Zscaler API details: hosts and URL construction verified against zscaler-sdk-python 1.11.3 (oneapi_oauth_client._get_auth_url, request_executor._resolve_api_base_url, zia/legacy.py); how the URL lookup spells an internationalised host and whether ZIA engines accept D<id>.U terms are assumed, not documented in the SDK.

Pre-existing on integrate/w6 and outside this area: tests/test_regression_flows.py::test_rule_migration_post_applies_the_planned_order_through_every_gate fails the same with this branch's changes reverted (plan_hash required).
